summary: Critical Metals Corp. filed a 6-K reporting completion of its acquisition of ASX-listed European Lithium Ltd. via two interdependent Australian schemes of arrangement (share scheme plus option scheme), the US equivalent of a court-approved merger. The Scheme Implementation Deed was signed May 18, 2026; shareholders and option holders approved October 22, 2026; the Supreme Court of Western Australia approved October 26; schemes became effective October 27. On the November 5, 2026 Implementation Date, Critical Metals issued 90,539,994 ordinary shares: 78,414,558 under the share scheme at a 0.045 exchange ratio per European Lithium share, 7,989,037 under the option scheme, and 4,136,399 for unlisted options and performance rights. European Lithium became wholly owned; its 45,536,338 Critical Metals shares have voting and dividend rights suspended and are treated as treasury, leaving 194,219,631 shares outstanding. Cash was about $264.5 million; earnout and investor agreements terminated. About 8.1 million replacement warrants were issued with $10.92–$15.60 vesting hurdles by end-2027. Watch integration and warrant overhang.
